The two real-network cases explicitly bind ephemeral loopback; the other twelve use original fake clocks/private-state fixtures. No GC or DOM hooks are used; original afterEach restores real timers/mocks and closes owned servers.

Transport package trees are pinned. Optional ws native peers are disabled per child via WS_NO_BUFFER_UTIL=1 and WS_NO_UTF_8_VALIDATE=1; real ws/tweetnacl/zod implementations remain. Native-addon/performance, full config and real SSH equivalence are not established.
runs.limits: Two real encrypted-loopback cases cover idle standing reconnection and reconnect remaining armed after the last logical subscription closes. Twelve original fake-clock/private-state cases cover active/idle ceilings, four simulated capped retries with upper jitter, eight intent/capability combinations, retryNow, and late-close suppression. Finite simulated retries do not establish infinite operational stability. No real SSH/Tailscale, half-open link, resumed-stream content, remote-work cancellation, native Electron or rewritten-product parity is proved.

sourceConfigDifferences: Both configurations use node. Execute this capsule with an explicit original installed Vitest 4.1.11 entry; runner receipts record the actual version/path.
The minimal capsule omits root renderer aliases, ORCA_FEATURE_WALL_ENABLED and the three DOM/host-port setup files; none is referenced by this source closure.

The capsule omits root execArgv webstorage/GC options and the Windows maxWorkers override, and uses default timeouts rather than root 30s test/60s hook timeouts. Timers and clock are controlled by the original tests. This does not establish full source-environment equivalence.
runs.limits: The source schedules only a fake interval inside its isolated Vitest worker. Its callbacks cannot perform network or process actions. No real socket, SSH connection, user session, credential, filesystem or application is touched by the staged source. The onDead callback describes a socket probe deadline, not evidence that a remote process exited; this baseline does not verify process liveness, reconnect integration, Drogon parity or actual suspend/resume on any OS.
